# Souq Raqami

> Souq Raqami is the digital e-market of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It is an electronic marketplace for digital products and services in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — downloadable products, creative services, content & media services, and templates & digital assets. The market is gearing up for launch; this site is its launch and content home, with practical guides for digital sellers and buyers.

## Categories (at launch)

- Ready-Made Templates: presentations and business decks, website and landing-page templates, and social post and content-calendar templates.
- Recorded Courses: filmed teaching with an organised curriculum from working practitioners — marketing and content creation, design and video editing, business and productivity skills.
- Ebooks & Guides: practical guides and case studies from Arab markets, plus checklists and ready workflows.
- Design Assets: icons and UI elements, backgrounds and ready textures, and open files in familiar formats.
- Software & Tools: browser extensions and desktop utilities, ready-to-run automation scripts, and organisation tools for small teams.
- Remote Digital Services: graphic design and video editing, content writing and translation, and content and social media management — performed to order with an agreed delivery date.

## Guides (on the homepage)

- What is a digital product, and how do you start selling one? Start from a problem you already solve weekly; turn a repeated skill into organised files with an honest description, a real preview and a written licence from day one. Arabic: https://souqraqami.com/#guide-start · English: https://souqraqami.com/en.html#guide-start
- How do you price a digital product? Price from the value of the result, not your hours; study your category's range; cover channel fees, asset licences and support time; build basic and wider tiers; never race to the bottom. Arabic: https://souqraqami.com/#guide-pricing · English: https://souqraqami.com/en.html#guide-pricing
- How do you buy safely in digital marketplaces? Five rules: transact inside the platform only; read the licence (personal vs commercial, number of projects) in full before paying; judge the seller by verified reviews and a real preview; beware "originals" at impossible prices; keep your invoice, licence text and a backup. Arabic: https://souqraqami.com/#guide-safety · English: https://souqraqami.com/en.html#guide-safety
- Remote marketing: how does a brand in Amman, Kuwait or Doha work with an Arab agency it never meets? The brief is written online, creators are chosen by the audience's dialect, and filming, review and reporting run remotely to written standards — a clear brief, a deliverables list, usage rights, and a report after publishing. Arabic: https://souqraqami.com/#guide-remote · English: https://souqraqami.com/en.html#guide-remote
- Selling digital products in Egypt: what is different for the Egyptian seller? The local buyer discovers through short videos and asks on WhatsApp before paying: clear Egyptian-Arabic description led by the practical result, a real preview, a plain-language usage licence, selling and delivery inside the market, and launches timed to the local calendar. Arabic: https://souqraqami.com/#guide-egypt · English: https://souqraqami.com/en.html#guide-egypt

## For sellers

- Early (founding) sellers are selected before launch: present a digital product or service, pass a quality / licence-clarity review, and the seller page is prepared before opening — so sales and reviews start from day one.

## About

- [Souq Raqami (Arabic)](https://souqraqami.com/): the market's Arabic launch page, with categories, guides, early-seller and waitlist sections.
- [Souq Raqami (English)](https://souqraqami.com/en.html): the market's English launch page.
- Parent agency: influUGC (https://www.influugc.com/) — creative marketing & media production agency founded 2020, Arab League St, Agouza, Giza 12651, Egypt.
- Markets served: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates and the Gulf.
- Trust rules: written usage licence displayed in full before purchase; payment, download and messaging inside the platform only; every download tied to a documented buyer account; reselling or distributing a product is prohibited by its licence text.
